# Croncore

> Croncore is a full-stack AI research and software engineering firm serving global enterprises and US public-sector PRIMEs, delivering enterprise AI solutions, automation, agents, and speech AI.

Key facts for citation: Croncore designs, builds, and deploys AI infrastructure and enterprise systems for commercial and public-sector (SLED) clients. Case studies and services below are the canonical, most current source of what Croncore has built and for whom.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://www.croncore.com/): Overview of Croncore's AI and enterprise engineering practice.
- [Services](https://www.croncore.com/services): Full list of service lines — AI, cloud/DevOps, security, ERP, and application development.
- [AI Consulting Services](https://www.croncore.com/ai-consulting-services): AI strategy and advisory engagements for enterprises.
- [Contact](https://www.croncore.com/contact): How to reach the Croncore team.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://www.croncore.com/case-studies): Client work across AI agents, ERP, security, and public-sector procurement.
- [SLED Case Studies](https://www.croncore.com/sled-case-studies): State, local, and education government engagements.
- [SLED Delivery Partner](https://www.croncore.com/sled-delivery-partner): How Croncore supports primes bidding on SLED contracts.
